info.title: Enterprise LMS API
info.description: Generated from the routes the server actually mounts. Every route is listed with its authentication and required roles; request and response schemas are filled in for the documented endpoints and are being extended. Errors are `{ error, details?, requestId }`.

get.summary: This description of the API.

For the reverse proxy's on-demand TLS (Caddy `ask`): 200 when a certificate may be issued for `domain` (a verified custom domain, or `<slug>.<TENANT_BASE_DOMAIN>` of an organisation that is not archived), otherwise 404. Requires TLS_ASK_SECRET as the X-TLS-Ask-Secret header or `secret` (403 otherwise); 404 for everything when it is not configured. Not for browsers: keep /internal/* unreachable from the internet.

404.description: Not a host of the platform, or the check is off (no TLS_ASK_SECRET)

the assertion consumer service.

303.description: Assertion consumer service: the identity provider posts a form-encoded SAMLResponse here. On success sets the session cookie and redirects (303) to the app root (/); otherwise to /login?error=sso_failed. Browser redirect with a Location header. Failures never show a reason to the browser: they redirect to the login page with ?error=sso_failed (or sso_unavailable when single sign-on is not set up).

get.summary: redirects the browser to the identity provider with an AuthnRequest.

302.description: Redirects to the identity provider with an AuthnRequest (sets the signed lms_saml flow cookie). Browser redirect with a Location header. Failures never show a reason to the browser: they redirect to the login page with ?error=sso_failed (or sso_unavailable when single sign-on is not set up).

302.description: Where the identity provider sends the browser back. On success sets the session cookie and redirects to the app root (/); otherwise to /login?error=sso_failed. get.summary: redirects to the identity provider.

302.description: Redirects to the identity provider's authorization endpoint (PKCE, state and nonce; sets the signed lms_sso flow cookie). Browser redirect with a Location header.
